$comment: FredPD mapping for the patched qbx_police (resource qbx_policejob; patches/qbx_policejob.*.patch, docs/modules/police.md). scripts/build.mjs copies it to fredpd_core/config/, where the patched qbx_police reads it with LoadResourceFile while fredpd_core is started; without it the built-in defaults (identical to this file) apply. Grants are 'type:key' (docs/contracts.md C2); 'duty' = on duty only, no grant. Keys are lower case: weapon keys are the ox_inventory item name (weapon:weapon_pistol), vehicle keys the model (vehicle:police3), armory access 'armory:<armory id>', other armory items 'armory:<item name>'.

garage.$comment: vehicles: { model: label } offered at the qbx_police garage, each gated by vehicle:<model>; {} = every model in qbx_police config/client.lua authorizedVehicles (all grades) + whitelistedVehicles. maxDistance: metres between the officer and the spawn point.

armories.$comment: <armory id>: { label, coords [x, y, z], radius, items }; access needs armory:<armory id>. items: count = handed out per take; max = no take while the officer already carries that many (ox_inventory GetItemCount), omit for no limit.

oxShops.$comment: ox_inventory shop type -> FredPD armory id: opening needs armory:<id>, every purchase is re-checked against the item grants (ox_inventory buyItem/openShop hooks).

radar.$comment: qbx_police ANPR cameras (config/client.lua radars, off by default): a pass is accepted only from the driver of a vehicle with that plate within maxDistance metres of the camera; one fredpd:boloHit per plate and camera per cooldownSeconds.
